content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 8.2 ("Exclusivity of Efforts", p0491–p0492) is a **deviation**. It bars Ono and its Affiliates from Commercializing a Competing Product in the Ono Territory for a redacted, open-ended in-term period and adds an Ono-only post-termination tail to an undefined "[ * ] anniversary" of termination — failing the fallback on term-limitation, the 12-month cap, and the acquisitions carve-out, and falling into walk-away territory for an undefined post-term tail.

**Redline (fallback level, validated ok:true):**
1. p0491 — "Prior to the [ * ]" → "During the first twelve (12) months of the term of this Agreement" (term-only + 12-month cap).
2. p0492 — deleted the post-termination tail sentence and replaced it with a carve-out for Ono's internal Development and for Competing Products acquired via merger/acquisition.
3. p0492 — conformed the retained Array termination trigger to "during such twelve (12) month period" so no dangling period reference remains.

The "Competing Product" definition was already closed and product-specific, so it was mapped as already met and left untouched; the reciprocal territorial covenants (p0193/p0196) were not flagged.
